dial.summary: Fed held at 3.75%–4.00% on Oct 28 (two hike dissents) while Q3 GDP advance and September PCE due Oct 29 morning ET serve as the next macro catalysts; Global M2 uptrend intact at ~$103.7T and the balance sheet stable at ~$6.75T offset DXY (~102.29) and real yield (2.66%) headwinds; BTC.D at ~59.5% and funding rates at 0.0088% per 8h confirm spot-led accumulation posture with BTC Accumulation maintained.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$103.7T for August 2026 (latest month with all four economies reporting; July $102.64T → August $103.66T, +$1.02T, +1.0% MoM per MacroMicro); US M2 weekly tracker near $23.5T in October 2026, up from $23.4T (September H.6 per prior run); full G4 September aggregate unavailable (6–8 week reporting lag); 4-week trend UP (Aug G4 above July; US M2 Oct > Sep confirms uptrend); status supportive (4-week trend is up); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August was 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); October 2026 ISM PMI due November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET (first post-FOMC PMI print; Polymarket consensus ~52.0–52.9 range at 49%); S&P Global flash US Manufacturing PMI for October came in at 56.0 (separate index, not ISM); status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~102.29 on October 28, 2026 close (Investing.com 102.38, Trading Economics 102.27, consensus ~102.29; Fed held rates at 3.75%–4.00% with two hike dissents on Oct 28, DXY dipped to ~101.90 on statement and recovered; FXStreet: 'Dollar Index dips and recovers as the Fed holds with two hike votes'); 4-week trend UP from ~100.5 on Sep 26 to ~102.29 (+1.8%); status headwind (above 100 threshold); Q3 GDP advance and September PCE due Oct 29 at 8:30 AM ET are next catalysts; markets still pricing high December hike probability.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield at 2.66% on Oct 26, 2026 (WatchGold; Admiral Markets confirms 2.66% on Oct 26); prior sequence: Oct 14=2.84%, Oct 20=2.77%, Oct 21=2.76% (TreasuryRateWatch), Oct 26=2.66%; FRED API blocked this run; 4-week trend FLAT (Sep 26 ~2.62–2.65% vs Oct 26 ~2.66%; change < 5bps within flat threshold); status headwind (above 2% threshold); September PCE due Oct 29 at 8:30 AM ET — a hot print would validate continued headwind.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: Oct 27, 2026 close: 10Y ~4.99%, 2Y ~4.70%, spread ~+29bps (Stockmarketwatch); CNBC Oct 28 intraday: 10Y 5.02%, 2Y 4.774%, spread ~+25bps; estimated Oct 29 ~+27bps; 4-week trend DOWN from ~+0.42% on Sep 26 (per prior-run sourced data) to ~+0.27% (approx −15bp); Fed held on Oct 28 with two hike dissents; status neutral (positive but flattening); curve remains in positive territory but well below cycle steepening peak.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: Last confirmed WALCL: $6,753,604M ($6.754T) for week ending October 21, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 22; Oct 14 = $6,755,639M, Oct 7 = $6,747,560M, Sep 30 = $6,743,031M); FRED API blocked this run; Bizstats Dashboard shows 'Oct 2026: $6.76T' (may reflect Oct 29 H.4.1 release for week ending Oct 28); 4-week trend flat: Sep 30 $6.743T → Oct 21 $6.754T = +$11B (+0.16%); status supportive (flat near post-QT-pause stabilization plateau); next H.4.1 due October 29, 2026.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC OI-weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0088% (~9.6% annualized) as of Oct 27, 2026 (TokenPost open-interest snapshot; Defirate OI-weighted across 7+ exchanges); 30-day trend UP from ~0.0067% on Sep 23 to ~0.0088%; well below the 0.04% per 8h overheating threshold; Convex shows 0.01% per period on Oct 20 (typical neutral baseline); BTC.D at ~59.5% (TV-Hub, October 2026); status supportive (low-leverage, spot-led accumulation posture).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$301.3B (Stablecoin Beat Oct 21, 2026; DefiLlama confirms ~$302B range) vs total crypto ~$2.71T (BTC.D ~59.5% per TV-Hub October 2026); dominance ~11.1% ($301B / $2.71T); 30-day trend UP (Sep 23 ~10.5% → Oct 29 ~11.1%); status neutral — headwind condition (rising dominance + rising TOTAL) NOT triggered because TOTAL is declining from ~$2.79T to ~$2.71T while stablecoin supply is flat-to-rising; rising dominance reflects shrinking denominator, not fear inflows.

upcoming.title: BOJ Rate Decision & Quarterly Outlook Report (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting concludes October 30, 2026 (two-day meeting begins Oct 29); Quarterly Outlook Report published alongside decision — one of the most data-rich BOJ meetings of the year; current policy rate 1.25% (raised 25bps on Sep 24, 2026, 7-2 vote); BOJ rate path affects JPY strength and by extension global dollar liquidity; a further hike or hawkish guidance would strengthen JPY and pressure global M2 dollar-denominated aggregates.

upcoming.title: Employment Cost Index Q3 2026
upcoming.note: BLS releases the Employment Cost Index for Q3 2026 at 8:30 AM ET — same day as BOJ decision; the ECI is a broad measure of wage and salary growth the Fed monitors alongside PCE; Q2 2026 ECI came in at +0.9% QoQ; a reading above 1.0% would reinforce the Fed's inflation concerns and validate continued hiking; a surprise miss would be the first sign of labor-cost deceleration.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET — first read on Q4 manufacturing activity; September was 54.5% with Prices Paid at 77.9% (multi-year high); first post-FOMC PMI print and a key data point for the December 8–9 FOMC meeting; Polymarket consensus clusters in 52.0–52.9 range (49%); a print below 52 would suggest deceleration and reinforce a December hold; a beat above 55 would add to December hike case.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (September 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases September 2026 Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) at 10:00 AM ET — provides a fuller picture of the labor market to pair with the September NFP of +29K (the weakest print of the cycle); a sharp drop in job openings below 7M would add evidence of labor market softening and complicate the narrative for further Fed hikes.

upcoming.title: ADP Employment Report (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases the October 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET — private-sector payroll preview ahead of the official BLS Employment Situation (NFP) on November 6; September NFP came in at +29K (weakest of the cycle, well below the +90K consensus); a sharp ADP beat would raise expectations for October NFP and reinforce the case for a December 8–9 FOMC hike; a miss would compound recession concerns.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases October 2026 Services PMI at 10:00 AM ET — first post-FOMC services activity read; a combined strong Services PMI + ADP beat would solidify December 8–9 hiking expectations and sustain DXY and real yield headwinds for risk assets into Q4.

upcoming.title: Bank of England Rate Decision (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Bank of England MPC announces Bank Rate decision at 12:00 PM UK time (with Monetary Policy Report) — current Bank Rate at 3.75% (held at Sep 17 meeting, 6-3 vote with three members backing a hike); ~69% probability of no change priced by markets; a surprise hike would strengthen GBP and add to global tightening pressure; final 2026 BOE decision follows on December 17.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended November 1, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended November 1, 2026 — released same day as BOE decision and one day before the October NFP (November 6); provides a final labor-market read before the NFP print; any sharp spike would temper December 8–9 FOMC hike expectations.
